\[
I_{\text{out}} = c \ln(1 + I),\qquad c = \frac{255}{\ln 256}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input value from 0 to 255
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output value before rounding
- \(c\): The scale that maps 255 to 255

This is the log transformation of Gonzalez and Woods. The constant c makes 255 map to 255, and 0 maps to 0. The curve is steep for small values and flat for large ones. So the dark tones spread out over a wide range and the bright tones are pressed together. Value 1 becomes 31.9 and value 128 becomes 223.5.
